items.name: Summary
items.content:
At present, the device API has opened interfaces for user login, status acquisition, network settings, basic settings, advanced settings, log acquisition, and call control. Developers can use interface capabilities to achieve integration. The supported capabilities can be quickly previewed through directory navigation, and the directory tree can be aggregated and classified according to functional blocks.
All interfaces currently use HTTP protocol and JSON data format, and the return message format is as follows:
```
{
  "code": 0,
  "message": "xxx",
  "timestamp": 0,
  "data": {}
}
```
Code represents the interface return code: 0, indicating successful call;> 0 is the HTTP error return code< 0 is the application error return code. Please refer to the interface instructions for specific errors.
Message represents an interface operation prompt message, usually used for troubleshooting.
Timestamp represents the timestamp returned by the interface operation.
Data represents the application data returned by this operation, with different interfaces having different formats.
# Request URL Format
The format of the request URL varies depending on the identity authentication method. Please refer to the identity authentication instructions for details.

items.name: Authentication
items.content:
The former device WEB API uses two ways to authenticate.
Method 1: Use the API SessionID for authentication
Go through the user login interface API to get the API SessionID that you will use in the request. Remember, your API SessionID is secret! Do not share it with others or expose it in any client code (browser, application).
All API requests should include the SessionID (10-minute validity) you get in the HTTP header, in the following format:
```js
Cookie: SessionID=YOUR_LOGIN_SESSIONID
```
The request URL in this mode is：http://ip_address/api/v{version}/xxx
Method 2: Use the user name and password for authentication
The user name and password are the web account for logging in to the device. Each API request contains parameters in the requested url for identity verification.
The request URL in this mode is: password=MD5(password)
Password Indicates the md5 encrypted value of the user password
